title: Choose your seat
subtitle: This is the inside of your bus. Select an available seat.
refreshFailed: Seat availability could not be refreshed. Refresh before booking.
layoutNote: The front is at the top. Seat positions stay the same in both languages.
chooseFirst: Select an available seat to add it to your journey.
changed: A selected seat is no longer available. Please check your selection.
notReserved: Selection alone does not reserve a seat. Seats are held after passenger details are confirmed.
holdNote: After confirmation, your seats are held for 10 minutes to complete payment. Passengers cannot cancel bookings.
conflict: A selected seat is no longer available. Choose another seat.
uncertain: We could not confirm the request result. Check My bookings before trying again to avoid creating an additional reservation.
numberedOnly: This view shows seat numbers and availability only; physical positions are not defined for this bus.
facilitiesLayoutNote: The front is at the top. The WC is opposite seats 17–18, followed by the middle door opposite 19–20. Seat positions stay the same in both languages.
